def rat(nn,dd):
    # f*(1+sum d_j P^j) = sum a_i P^i  -> linear in coefficients
    cols=[P**i for i in range(nn+1)]+[-dP_dt*P**j for j in range(1,dd+1)]
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    cf,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dP_dt-X@cf)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), cf
